info.description: # napari-imaref [![License BSD-3](https://img.shields.io/pypi/l/napari-imaref.svg?color=green)](https://github.com/koopa31/napari-imaref/raw/main/LICENSE) [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/napari-imaref.svg?color=green)](https://pypi.org/project/napari-imaref) [![Python Version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/napari-imaref.svg?color=green)](https://python.org) [![tests](https://github.com/koopa31/napari-imaref/workflows/tests/badge.svg)](https://github.com/koopa31/napari-imaref/actions) [![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/koopa31/napari-imaref/branch/main/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/koopa31/napari-imaref) [![napari hub](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://api.napari-hub.org/shields/napari-imaref)](https://napari-hub.org/plugins/napari-imaref) Stereotyping 3D images of the zebrafish olfactory system by defining a reproducible reference frame. The method relies on ellipsoid fitting based on manually placed landmark points. ![](https://github.com/koopa31/ImaRef_doc/blob/main/docs/images/placer_points.gif?raw=true) ---------------------------------- This [napari] plugin was generated with [Cookiecutter] using [@napari]'s [cookiecutter-napari-plugin] template. ## Installation You can install `napari-imaref` via [pip] following these steps: 1) First create a Conda environment conda create -n napari_stereotyping python=3.11 2) Activate the Conda environment conda activate napari_stereotyping 3) Then install Napari (Napari versions after 0.6.6 are not compatible with the plugin.) pip install "napari[all]"==0.6.6 4) Install the plugin pip install napari-imaref ## Documentation A [documentation] is available to understand how to effectively learn how to use the plugin. ## Contributing Contributions are very welcome. If you manage to apply this method to other sample types, we’d love to hear about it! And if you’re considering adapting it to different biological systems but feel that a few modifications might be necessary, don’t hesitate to reach out. ## License Distributed under the terms of the [BSD-3] license, "napari-imaref" is free and open source software ## Issues If you encounter any problems, please [file an issue] along with a detailed description. [napari]: https://github.com/napari/napari [Cookiecutter]: https://github.com/audreyr/cookiecutter [@napari]: https://github.com/napari [MIT]: http://opensource.org/licenses/MIT [BSD-3]: http://opensource.org/licenses/BSD-3-Clause [GNU GPL v3.0]: http://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt [GNU LGPL v3.0]: http://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.txt [Apache Software License 2.0]: http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 [Mozilla Public License 2.0]: https://www.mozilla.org/media/MPL/2.0/index.txt [cookiecutter-napari-plugin]: https://github.com/napari/cookiecutter-napari-plugin [documentation]: https://imaref-doc.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ [file an issue]: https://github.com/koopa31/napari-imaref/issues [napari]: https://github.com/napari/napari [tox]: https://tox.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ [pip]: https://pypi.org/project/pip/ [PyPI]: https://pypi.org/
